tutorial: Fasteners_Workbench.md (the wiki's page for the add-on: select a hole's round edge, add a screw, change its parameters, flip, move, generate the BOM) on a plate with PartDesign Holes; the page gives no sizes, so the 80 x 40 x 10 bracket of the Make model is used. These tools are listed only when Fasteners Workbench is installed.

expected.labels: M6x16-Screw, M3x10-Screw: per size, not counting up at each recompute
expected.note: The lengths and BOM wording are Fasteners Workbench's own; its source was not among this pass's references, so those expectations are from Workshop's bridge code and tests/fasteners/, not from Fasteners' tables.

calls.expect: a new empty document
a PartDesign Body
a sketch on XY
an 80 x 40 rectangle
volume 32000
no printer allowance: the Holes keep FreeCAD's ISO 273 sizes
a 6.6 mm through Hole
count ≥ 1, types including { type "ISO4762", kind, what }, source naming Fasteners Workbench
sizes including "M3" and "M6", hasLength true
lengths (a list of the lengths M6 comes in, "16" among them), hole (pass and tap hole diameters)
REFUSED not_found, with near names when there are any

made[0] { type "ISO4762", size "M6" (matched to the 6.6 mm edge), length 16 (or "16"), thread "simple", matchOuter true, attachedTo "Bracket.EdgeN", edgeDiameter 6.6, label "M6x16-Screw", bom "ISO4762 Screw M6x16" or Fasteners' wording, hole "kept" }; health ok
a loose screw at [100, 0, 0]: no attachedTo, label "M3x10-Screw"
REFUSED invalid_input: no round edge of Bracket within 1 mm of that point, listing the nearest
fasteners [2], bom [{ item …M3x10, qty 1 }, { item …M6x16, qty 1 }], no warnings; a read (no undo step)
changed[0].length 20, the same object name; its label follows the size ("M6x20-Screw")
changed[0].label "Spare screw", kept after doc recompute
REFUSED invalid_input: objects are needed
the Hole as before (cut "ISO 4762", 11 x 6.4) and screw { … } : an ISO4762 M6 in it, its length from the hole (a through hole 10 mm: the nearest length), or screwNote saying why not
a later PartDesign feature: it renumbers the Body's edges, which is what the keeper is for
each attached fastener says hole "kept" or "reattached" (never silently on another edge); a lost one is under warnings
sheet (a spreadsheet's label) and by ("Fasteners' Generate BOM" with the window up, else Workshop's in the same layout); this call changes the document
mode (standard | 3dprint), nut [1.03, 0.1] and screw [0.99, -0.05] unless the person changed them, formula, source; nothing is set
REFUSED invalid_input: mode is standard or 3dprint

notCovered: fastener_set restore: needs a file saved where Fasteners Workbench was not loaded
fastener_set type, edge, invert, offset, match (tests/fasteners/test_bridge.py)
fastener_print set: it changes the person's preference for every document; set it only on their word
adoption of fasteners made with Fasteners' own buttons (tests/fasteners/test_keep.py)
